title: A baby's sleep surface should be firm and flat, not tilted
summary: CDC says to use a firm, flat sleep surface that is not at an angle, such as a mattress in a safety-approved crib with a fitted sheet.
body: The safe-sleep page's next action is the surface. It says to use a firm, flat sleep surface, and it says flat means not at an angle or inclined. The example is a mattress in a safety-approved crib, covered by a fitted sheet. The page is stating a US recommendation CDC ties to the 2022 pediatrics guidance. It does not review a particular product by name, and a firm mattress is a different question from what belongs in the crib, which is the next card.

sources.title: Providing Care for Babies to Sleep Safely
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US federal page, public domain. CDC says it supports the 2022 AAP recommendations. Page updated 17 September 2024.
